title: Sorted Squares
statement: Given integers sorted in ascending order (they may be negative), return the squares of the numbers, also in ascending order, in O(n) time.

answerKey.pattern: Two pointers at both ends, filling the result from the back
keyPoints: The largest square is at one of the two ends
Compare the squares at left and right, write the larger at the end of the result
Move that pointer inward and fill the next position from the back
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Square everything and sort: O(n log n)

hints: Squaring and sorting is O(n log n). Where can the largest square be?
Only at the far left (a big negative) or the far right.
Fill the result from the last position backwards.
